title: Undergraduate Academic Calendar 2026/2027
text:
Sociology
The Sociology
Department
at Laurier is characterized by a strength in the area of Equity and Social Justice. A
core
course
on Social Inequality as well as the large number of upper-level course offerings, in areas such as  human rights, social movements, race and ethnic relations, gender relations, health, family, and disability, reflect this strength and the varied research areas of the
faculty
in the department. The aim of the
program
is to help students gain a better understanding of contemporary social issues, and to provide them with the theoretical, methodological, and writing skills to analyse and engage with these issues. Students are thus prepared for employment in, among other things, policy research and human service work. The program also prepares students to enter graduate studies in sociology and after-degree programs in social work, education, criminal justice, and law.
